summary: Part 3 of 4 of '7.0 Refund policy (Seller)' (06:52 to 09:42). Pierre explains the coloured markers on the Revibe App Claims list (yellow warning, orange policy to be applied for SA only, red policy applied, Resetted), the Seller Elapsed column, and the Seller Performance > Claims management > Refund policy view (On the clock / Moving / Stopped tiles, day-bucket charts, Methodology panel). Thresholds: SA warning on days 7 and 8 with the policy from day 9; AE, ZA and others warning on days 6 and 7 with the policy from day 8. All 40 frames were opened and checked against the transcript. Corrections in this pass: the yellow-marker reason (the policy, not the refund, is applied after two working days), 'also owns' removed from the SA ownership fact, the policy-day wording, the frame mapping for the Methodology and chart-pointing steps, the 08:41-09:21 frames (a slide, not the live page), the 'Seven' to '7' number, and the privacy note on the claims list (no seller names appear there). Speech words that are unreliable (revive, credited, South, 9, state) are resolved from the screen where the screen shows the value; the sample rows' marker colours do not match the hour values, and two policy-day wordings differ, so those points are listed as unclear.

unclear.issue: The pack transcript starts at 06:56 mid-sentence. The transcript has a 06:48 line ('color code {So?} yellow is the warning {So?} after day 6 in UAE and South Africa and other') and no lines from 06:49 to 06:55, so the opening explanation of the yellow marker is only partly known.

Two versions of the policy-day definition are shown on the live page. The Methodology text (t00565) says 'A policy day is 24 working hours, and only the seller's hours count', while the chart footer (t00562) reads 'A policy day is 24 weekday hours, on the Dubai calendar day'. Which wording is correct is not clear. The 120 and 168 working-hour figures from speech match 24 hours per day.

Sample rows do not visibly match the hour values on the slide. NGDK126 (SA-138489-3, orange marker, Action Pending) shows Seller Elapsed 120, and PJIR384 (red marker, Action Taken) shows 72. The slide does not say whether the marker follows elapsed hours, the status, or something else, so the marker-to-hours link is not stated as a fact.

The stage of the red-marked row PJIR384 is truncated on screen (reads 'Ready for ...'), so the exact stage name cannot be read. The spoken word in 'At this {state?}' is also unclear; the Stage column is the likely referent.

Which stages are seller-owned or Revibe-owned in each market is shown only as a two-row diagram with small dots and bars. The text confirms only that in SA the seller owns the collection and ship-back legs. Per-stage ownership is not stated as a fact; the Methodology panel itself should be checked.
The speech about other markets' start days is cut off ('probably even later once the'), so the policy start day for markets other than SA is not confirmed by the trainer.

Two dashboard snapshots show different numbers (slide at 08:52: 39 on the clock, 16 moving, 23 stopped; live page at 09:22: 37 on the clock, 36 moving, 1 stopped). These are different snapshots, not a conflict, but the numbers should not be quoted as current.
